pitfalls.readme_said: Linux release builds need: sudo apt install libasound2 libegl1 libpipewire-0.3-0 libva-drm2 libva2 xdg-desktop-portal
pitfalls.actually_needed: Without root, the npm binary failed with 'libasound.so.2: cannot open shared object file'. Fetched Debian trixie debs (libasound2t64, libva2, libva-drm2, libpipewire-0.3-0t64, libdrm2), extracted them with dpkg-deb -x into ~/.local/concord-libs, and ran with LD_LIBRARY_PATH set

pitfalls.readme_said: Debian or Ubuntu: libasound2 libpipewire-0.3-0 libva-drm2 libva2
pitfalls.actually_needed: The binary also loads libdrm.so.2 (libdrm2), which the README does not list. On Debian trixie the package names are libasound2t64 and libpipewire-0.3-0t64
